name: attendease
description: AttendEase — Smart College Attendance Management System (students + staff, 7 departments, SMS notifications)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
